authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL *ṭukk subsection 2 *ṭukka piece explicitly gives Gujarati ṭũk/ṭũkũ small/brief, alongside Punjabi ṭuk little and Hindi ṭuk a little. The selected simple ṭuk-/tuk- short responses match this regional adjectival use; nasalization, aspiration, gemination and dental/retroflex notation remain as transcribed and qualified. This uses the noun/adjective subsection 5466-2, not the cutting verb 5466. Turner calls the deeper connection with truṭ very doubtful; local IA transmission is also unresolved. Extra -l/-ḍ/-r forms are excluded pending evidence for their short sense. Exact response: tuko.
